excerpt.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
excerpt.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into [event_target:infested_planet.GetName]'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

texts.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
texts.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into [event_target:infested_planet.GetName]'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

texts.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从[root.GetName]的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
texts.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from [root.GetName]'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

texts.zh:
又一次，万华镜寄生虫锁死了我们的电网，消耗我们的能源供给，使行星陷入黑暗。

幸运的是，我们现在知道如何应对。
texts.en:
Once again, the Kaleidoscope has latched to our power grid, consuming our energy and plunging the planet into darkness.

Fortunately, we now know how to respond.
